title: Helena Lefroy
dates: (d.1908)
---

sister of Maria (Trench) Wilson

She married (1844) The Very Rev.

Jeffry Trench (1809-1885), third son of the Tom Lefroy who flirted with Jane Austen.

Her fourth son was the Rt.

Rev.

George Alfred Lefroy (b.1854), Bishop of Lahore. [Awdry, Heathcote]
